title: Mob Psycho 100 III Anime Marks 10th Anniversary With New Short
content: The " Mob Psycho 100 Anime 10th Anniversary Event: Reunion" presented a new anime short at the Fukagawa Mirai Hall in Kawaguchi City , Saitama on Sunday. The short, which is streaming online with English subtitles, features Reigen, Shigeo ("Mob"), Dimple, and Tome at the Spirits and Such Consultation Office.
author: ANN

title: 3 Biggest The Apothecary Diaries Projects in 2026
content: 2026 is by far the most exciting year for The Apothecary Diaries fans, with more updates and releases than ever. Written by Hyūganatsu, it is one of the biggest franchises in recent years, as the light novel and manga volumes have over 45 million copies in circulation.

title: Darkroom Streaming Service Adds Crusher Joe, Simoun, More Anime
content: Streaming service Darkroom announced on Tuesday that it has added the following anime: • Crusher Joe • Crusher Joe: A Trap of the Frozen Jail (Crusher Joe: The OVA's) • Crusher Joe: The Final Weapon ASH (Crusher Joe: The OVA's) • Haré+Guu Deluxe • Haré+Guu FINAL • Simoun The Crusher Joe film debuted in 1983.

title: Mob Psycho 100 New Original Anime Short Released for 10th Anniversary
content: Mob Psycho 100 has released a brand-new animated short movie by the original staff to celebrate the anime’s 10th anniversary. The video debuted during the “ Mob Psycho 100 Anime 10th Anniversary Event: Reunion,” held on July 12 in Japan.
author: Anime Corner

title: Kiki's Delivery Service Illustrator Akiko Hayashi Dies at 81
content: Japanese news outlet The Mainichi reported on Wednesday children's book author and illustrator Akiko Hayashi died of pneumonia on July 1 in a hospital in Nagano prefecture. She was 81.
author: ANN

title: One Piece Episode 1169 Preview Trailer Teases Scopper Gaban
content: ONE PIECE revealed the preview for Episode 1169, teasing Scopper Gaban appearing on Elbaph. The anime is returning after a 1-week break, which was made for the ONE PIECE HEROINES episode. The anime previously returned after a 3-month break on April 5, with the crew reaching the giants’ Elbaph Island.

title: Smoking Behind the Supermarket with You Creditless Opening & Ending Videos Released
content: Smoking Behind the Supermarket with You anime revealed the creditless version of its opening and ending videos following the premiere on July 9, 2026. Ahead of the TV premiere, ABEMA streamed a special early-release version of the series.
